newsitem.title: UK: ExDresdner Kleinwort chairman joins Goldman Sachs.
newsitem.headline: ExDresdner Kleinwort chairman joins Goldman Sachs.

text.p: Simon Robertson, the former chairman of Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, will become managing director and president of Goldman Sachs Europe Ltd, the investment bank said on Thursday.
Robertson will take up his position on September 1. He is also expected to become a partner of Goldman Sachs at the beginning of its new fiscal year on December 1.
Key client relationships and setting the course of the firm's global investment banking strategy will be among his responsibilities, Goldman Sachs said.
Robertson, 56, said he looked forward to assisting the firm in developing its international business.
Dresdner Kleinwort Benson is the investment banking arm of Dresdner Bank AG.
